General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This is the NEW Suzuki OEM Radiator Fan.
This fan is the OEM replacement Fan for the Suzuki Samurai.
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
NOTE: We encourage all Samurai owners to replace a broken fan with a new fan rather than buying one used. This is because the plastic becomes brittle as the fan ages and even a used fan that looks good is very susceptible to failing.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Radiator Fan
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
